title: LandlordGuard Returned-Payment Fee Tenure Credit Table
content:
**Table.** The returned-fee tenure credit on the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy looks at whole months from the original effective date to the charge date: 120 months or more take 10.00 USD off; 60 to 119 months take 5.00 USD off; fewer than 60 months take nothing off.

The tenure credit is taken off in the returned-fee adjustment.

| Whole months from the original effective date to the charge date | Returned-fee tenure credit |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 10.00 USD off |
| 60 to 119 | 5.00 USD off |
| fewer than 60 | nothing |

The original effective date is the policy's first inception date, not the start of the current term.

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical dates, charge date 10 October 2025)

| Original effective date | Whole months | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 10 October 2015 | 120 | 10.00 USD |
| 11 October 2015 | 119 | 5.00 USD |
| 10 October 2020 | 60 | 5.00 USD |
| 11 October 2020 | 59 | nothing |
